description: Every immutable identity the publish workflows, the build sandbox and this workspace's tests depend on. `npm run pins:check` proves the ledger and the files agree in both directions: a workflow reference absent from the ledger fails, and a ledger entry no file uses fails.

actions.purpose: Check out the bound source revision and the pinned publish toolchain.
Install the Node.js distribution pinned by .node-version.
Direct-upload every exact-ID carrier with overwrite: false.
Download only the exact carrier IDs a job consumes.
Issue the optional provenance attestation over the frozen envelope's exact subject.
Issue the optional SBOM attestation over the frozen envelope's exact subject with sbom-path pointing at the extracted metadata/sbom.spdx.json record (DEC-097 section 6).

containerImages.name: minio
containerImages.purpose: Throwaway S3-compatible server for the opt-in do-spaces conformance run.

binaries.name: spdx-schema-2.3
binaries.purpose: The unmodified official SPDX 2.3 JSON Schema freeze validates every SBOM against (DEC-097 section 6); vendored at scripts/workflow/spdx/spdx-schema-2.3.json and hash-checked at load.

selfReferences.reason: The fixed caller in docs/callers/ pins the exact rathnasgala2/publish commit the author is told to use. W0-01 has published this repository (verified 2026-09-25), so the documented example now carries a real commit SHA -- rathnasgala2/publish's main HEAD at reconciliation time -- instead of the all-zero placeholder it could only carry before this repository existed. The author still replaces it with whatever commit Gala tells them to pin; S3 admits a caller only when this pin is a real full commit SHA.
